```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(bnlearn)
```

```{r}
data = read_csv("../../data/data_preliminar.csv")
head(data)
```
```{r}
colnames(data) = c("COL_HDL", "COL_LDL", "CREAT", "GLU_SUERO", "INSULINA", "PCR", "TRIG", "HB1AC", "SO_2","CO","NOx", "COV", "PM_010", "PM_2_5", "NH_3") #Mismo orden de las columnas 
head(data)
```

```{r}
dag <- model2network("[SO_2][CO][NOx][COV][PM_010][PM_2_5][NH_3][PCR|SO_2:CO:NOx:COV:PM_010:PM_2_5:NH_3][COL_HDL|PCR][COL_LDL|PCR][TRIG|COL_HDL:COL_LDL:PCR][CREAT|PCR][INSULINA|TRIG:PCR:CREAT][GLU_SUERO|INSULINA:TRIG:PCR][HB1AC|GLU_SUERO]")
```


```{r}
blood_fit = bn.fit(dag, data=data)
```

```{r}
graphviz.plot(dag, shape = "ellipse")
```


```{r}
blood_fit$TRIG
```

```{r}
score(dag, data=data, type="bic-g")
```


```{r}
score(dag, data=data, type="aic-g")
```
